title: Tyson and the Big Splash
description: A stick, a flying hat, and one small fish.
subtitle: Tyson and Dad go fishing. A stick, a flying hat, and one small fish.

cover.alt: Tyson casting his fishing line from a boat on a sunny lake.

blocks.html: Tyson and his dad, Alex, went to the lake. Tyson had his rod. Dad had the worms. Both had their life jackets on.
“I will catch a big fish!” said Tyson. Dad put a worm on the hook. Tyson cast his line. Plop! His red float sat on the water.

blocks.alt: Tyson casting his fishing line from a boat on a sunny lake while Dad holds the net and a duck swims nearby.
blocks.caption: Tyson casts his line as a duck swims past.

blocks.html: They sat. They waited. A duck swam past. “Do you know where the fish are?” Tyson asked it. “Quack,” said the duck. “That was not much help,” said Dad.
Then the float went down. “Dad! I have one!” Tyson held his rod up. He turned the reel. The line pulled hard. “It must be huge!” he said.
Dad got the net. Tyson reeled some more. Up came a stick.

blocks.alt: Tyson laughing in the boat holding up a stick on his fishing line while Dad holds the net.
blocks.caption: Up came a stick — not quite a fish.

blocks.html: Tyson stared at it. Dad stared at it. “That fish has a lot of legs,” said Dad.
Tyson laughed so hard his hat fell off. Dad caught it in the net. “One stick and one hat!” said Tyson.

blocks.alt: Tyson's baseball cap flying off his head into Dad's fishing net as they both laugh in the boat.
blocks.caption: Tyson laughs so hard his hat flies into Dad's net.

blocks.html: He tried again. This time, he cast near some weeds. Plop. Wait. Tug! A small fish flashed in the sun. Dad helped bring it in.
“My first real fish!” said Tyson. It was no bigger than his hand. Dad took a photo. Then they let the fish go. Splash! Water hit Dad right on the nose.

blocks.alt: Tyson proudly holding up a tiny fish while Dad takes a photo, then a big splash of water.
blocks.caption: His first real fish — no bigger than his hand.

blocks.html: Tyson grinned. “Small fish. Big splash!” On the way home, Dad asked, “What was your best catch?” “The fish,” said Tyson. “But you caught a pretty nice hat.”
